title: App Store featuring nomination and iPhone Duo launch video
summary: The marketing beat for the Duo features: an App Store featuring nomination citing Duo adoption, submitted with the v1 build, and the launch video with the unfold as its second beat (Design Skills rule 28: 3 s real room, the shrink, 10 s of play, publish, a friend plays).

acceptance_tests.test: Featuring nomination submitted in App Store Connect with the Duo story (stand-mode console layout, unfold transition, rear-camera capture) and the diorama hero shot; submission confirmation attached.
Launch video storyboard and final cut per Design Skills rule 28, with the unfold beat from M3-DUO-02's recording plan and stand-mode play; assets at App Store preview sizes.
Screenshot set includes the stand-mode console layout; hashtags #GiganticJourneys #iPhoneDuo in the listing copy where the store allows.
